correctness.rationale: All 12 cube edges and nine perfect matchings are constructed exhaustively; the original complex has 99 nonempty faces. The nine-vertex facet nerve has 12 free-edge/triangle collapses to a connected graph of cycle rank four, giving the homology concentration used in the Hopf trace formula. Exhaustive signed Lefschetz calculations on both original complex and nerve agree with sign(sigma)+sum over fixed coordinates of (-1)^b_j for all 48 automorphisms; the 10 signed-cycle classes account for all 48. Character matching and rational irreducibility of the one-dimensional permutation sign and natural signed-coordinate module establish the precise decomposition. Independent mod-p boundary ranks p=2,3,5,7 confirm homology. No unproved infinite extension, integral splitting, or equivariant homotopy inference is made.

value.rationale: The complete 48-element rational symmetry character is meaningful for an exceptional highly symmetric cubical graph whose earlier known nonequivariant four-circle homotopy type suppresses the group action. The new decomposition separates an irreducible three-dimensional signed-coordinate component from a one-dimensional permutation-sign line and yields a central-inversion trace -2 and eigenspace dimensions one and three. This natural full-octahedral refinement is not determined by the existing Betti calculation and does not merely rename an established graph-family theorem.
